projectDescription: RutaMovil (Sicher) is a React Native mobile app for road safety management that connects transportistas, autoridades, and administrators to report, approve, and track traffic accidents in real time.
keyFeatures: Interactive map with real-time GPS and route navigation (Google Maps + react-native-maps)
Accident reporting with photos, victims, and vehicle data
Three distinct user roles: Transportista, Autoridad, and Admin
Firebase push notifications for accident status updates
Real-time WebSocket feed for live accident events (STOMP over SockJS)
Accident approval workflow for authority users
Route tracking and history for transportistas
Admin dashboard with system logs and reports
Offline-tolerant GPS with adaptive precision algorithm
Google Sign-In and email/password authentication (Firebase Auth)
publicApiSurface: POST /autoridades/fcm-token — save FCM push token for autoridad
POST /transportistas/fcm-token — save FCM push token for transportista
GET /reportes/rutas/transportista/:id — get route history for a transportista
WebSocket /topic/accidentes — subscribe to live accident events (STOMP)
